summary: Omit roster subagents for drivers that do not report them instead of reporting a false empty list.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Agent rows omit the optional subagents field unless their driver is claude, codex, or omp. Pi and OpenCode do not report subagents. Clients can distinguish not reported from a reported empty list; the wire field shape is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond the normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Normal rollback is supported; an older daemon may again report empty subagent lists for drivers without observers.
